name: jev-model-router
description: Ask jev-model-router which model and effort should do a task before delegating it, and report how it went.

interface.shortDescription: Pick the model and effort for each delegated task
interface.longDescription: Before delegating a task, ask jev-model-router which model and reasoning effort are cheapest while likely to succeed; after the task's check runs, report pass or fail so the router learns each model's real success rate.
